_note: Read-only tools offered to the query assistant via function calling. The model picks tools and arguments; platform code runs them. period is one of: today, this_week, last_week, this_month, last_month, this_year, all_time.

tools.name: get_sales_summary
tools.purpose: Completed-sales revenue, units, orders and AOV for a period

tools.name: get_top_items
tools.purpose: Best-selling items or variants by revenue or units

tools.name: get_purchase_summary
tools.purpose: Purchase totals, optionally by supplier, item, brand or category

tools.name: get_inventory_health
tools.purpose: Current stock, stock value, low-stock and negative-stock variants

tools.name: get_financial_position
tools.purpose: Current cash, inventory, deposits, receivables, payables, prepayments

tools.name: get_volume_forecast
tools.purpose: Saved next-month unit forecast (units only); low-confidence results need explicit acknowledgement
